name: 1f3f0df5-enum-width
description: Регресс ошибки 1f3f0df5: ячейка-перечисление редактора отбора (`.fv-enum` внутри `.ft-row__value`) получает ширину колонки значения; выбранные значения «Тип действия» и «Вид сущности» видны подписями в чипах, ширина чипа и подписи > 0. Запуск: node client/scripts/ui-probe-stand.mjs --scenario client/scripts/ui-probe.1f3f0df5-enum-width.scenario.json

steps.name: pick-created
steps.eval: (async () => { const p=document.querySelector('.ui-popover.ui-chip-checklist-popover'); const inp=[...p.querySelectorAll('input')].find((i)=>i.value==='created'); if(!inp) return 'no-created'; inp.checked=true; inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); await new Promise((r)=>setTimeout(r,60)); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: pick-updated
steps.eval: (async () => { const p=document.querySelector('.ui-popover.ui-chip-checklist-popover'); const inp=[...p.querySelectorAll('input')].find((i)=>i.value==='updated'); if(!inp) return 'no-updated'; inp.checked=true; inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); await new Promise((r)=>setTimeout(r,60)); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: action-enum-widths
steps.probe: (() => { const row=document.querySelector('.activity-filter .ft-row'); const cell=row.querySelector('.ft-row__value'); const box=row.querySelector('.fv-enum'); const list=row.querySelector('.fv-enum .ui-chip-list'); const add=row.querySelector('.fv-enum .ui-chip-list-add--checklist'); const chips=[...row.querySelectorAll('.fv-enum .ui-chip')]; const labels=[...row.querySelectorAll('.fv-enum .ui-chip-label')]; const w=(e)=>e===null||e===undefined?-1:Math.round(e.getBoundingClientRect().width*100)/100; return JSON.stringify({cell:w(cell),box:w(box),list:w(list),add:w(add),chips:chips.map(w),labels:labels.map(w),texts:labels.map((l)=>l.textContent)}); })()

steps.name: action-enum-chips-nonzero
steps.probe: (() => { const chips=[...document.querySelectorAll('.activity-filter .fv-enum .ui-chip')]; const labels=[...document.querySelectorAll('.activity-filter .fv-enum .ui-chip-label')]; const list=document.querySelector('.activity-filter .fv-enum .ui-chip-list'); const box=document.querySelector('.activity-filter .fv-enum'); return chips.length===2 && box!==null && box.getBoundingClientRect().width>0 && list!==null && list.getBoundingClientRect().width>0 && chips.every((c)=>c.getBoundingClientRect().width>0) && labels.length===2 && labels.every((l)=>l.getBoundingClientRect().width>0 && (l.textContent??'').trim()!==''); })()

steps.name: entity-enum-chips-nonzero
steps.probe: (() => { const row=document.querySelector('.activity-filter .ft-row[data-path="1"]'); const chips=[...row.querySelectorAll('.fv-enum .ui-chip')]; const labels=[...row.querySelectorAll('.fv-enum .ui-chip-label')]; const list=row.querySelector('.fv-enum .ui-chip-list'); return chips.length===1 && list!==null && list.getBoundingClientRect().width>0 && chips.every((c)=>c.getBoundingClientRect().width>0) && labels.length===1 && labels.every((l)=>l.getBoundingClientRect().width>0 && (l.textContent??'').trim()!==''); })()

steps.name: narrow-value-cell
steps.eval: (() => { const cell=document.querySelector('.activity-filter .ft-row .ft-row__value'); cell.style.flex='0 0 160px'; cell.style.width='160px'; const box=cell.querySelector('.fv-enum'); const list=cell.querySelector('.fv-enum .ui-chip-list'); return JSON.stringify({cell:Math.round(cell.getBoundingClientRect().width),box:Math.round(box.getBoundingClientRect().width),list:Math.round(list.getBoundingClientRect().width)}); })()

steps.name: narrow-panel-widths
steps.probe: (() => { const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll('.activity-filter .ft-row')]; const list=rows[0].querySelector('.fv-enum .ui-chip-list'); const chips=[...rows[0].querySelectorAll('.fv-enum .ui-chip')]; const labels=[...rows[0].querySelectorAll('.fv-enum .ui-chip-label')]; const w=(e)=>e===null||e===undefined?-1:Math.round(e.getBoundingClientRect().width*100)/100; const h=(e)=>e===null||e===undefined?-1:Math.round(e.getBoundingClientRect().height*100)/100; return JSON.stringify({list:w(list),chips:chips.map(w),labels:labels.map(w),rowHeights:rows.map(h)}); })()

steps.name: narrow-panel-keeps-chips-visible
steps.probe: (() => { const row=document.querySelector('.activity-filter .ft-row'); const list=row.querySelector('.fv-enum .ui-chip-list'); const chips=[...row.querySelectorAll('.fv-enum .ui-chip')]; const labels=[...row.querySelectorAll('.fv-enum .ui-chip-label')]; const lw=list.getBoundingClientRect().width; return lw>0 && lw<=170 && chips.length===2 && chips.every((c)=>c.getBoundingClientRect().width>0 && c.getBoundingClientRect().width<=lw+0.5) && labels.every((l)=>l.getBoundingClientRect().width>0 && (l.textContent??'').trim()!=='') && row.getBoundingClientRect().height<200; })()
